text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Ah―― Good morning.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
So for today's training menu, you 
scheduled a perimeter run for me.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
The azaleas and hydrangeas are in full 
bloom. That's why I'm so happy—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Well, with that in mind—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu, now I'm looking forward to it even 
more. I'll be in your care today as well.

Determined to live up to the fans' 
expectations, the days of training 
relentlessly for the Takarazuka Kinen 
continued.
Then, one day――

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I really do get nervous, after all. 
Especially with so many cameras present...

To our surprise, a documentary crew was 
assigned to cover us closely.

text_block_list.name: Show Director
text_block_list.text:
"Project U: Hoofprints to Victory"— This 
is a streaming show focused on the bonds 
between Umamusume and their Trainers.

text_block_list.name: Show Director
text_block_list.text:
"As partners for our very first broadcast, 
we would love for the two of you to 
appear."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: It is a great honor. But why us—?

text_block_list.name: Show Director
text_block_list.text:
I felt it after seeing your interview 
article in Monthly Twinkle, as well as the 
TV shows the two of you appeared on 
together.

text_block_list.name: Show Director
text_block_list.text:
While many Umamusume naturally hold grand 
dreams of claiming glory—

text_block_list.name: Show Director
text_block_list.text:
Anytime, anywhere, at the very core of 
your dream, there has only ever been 
Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Show Director
text_block_list.text:
Our documentary's theme is the deep bond 
between Umamusume and Trainer. The two of 
you are truly the perfect fit.

The shooting schedule was also arranged so 
that it wouldn't interfere with training 
or races.

At a time like this, I want to increase 
her public exposure in order to make her 
presence known far and wide.

If it isn't stressful for her, I'd gladly 
take it on—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—Personally, I would be delighted if you 
introduced me to your Trainer.

And so, days of close-up media coverage 
between training sessions began.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: “Curren Bouquetd'or and Trainer <username>”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I want to unravel the paths walked by 
these two who share a certain aura, and 
look toward their future—"

text_block_list.name: Show AD
text_block_list.text:
We'll basically be keeping the cameras 
rolling the entire time. It might take 
some getting used to, but please just go 
about your day as normal.

text_block_list.name: Show AD
text_block_list.text: Well then, here goes—!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Ah... Um, just like, usual—
choice_data_list: Shall we check the training details?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Y—Yes!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
You want to improve your running economy 
even further—is that right?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it—I learned once that 
having the stamina to avoid gassing out at 
the end is crucial for the Takarazuka 
Kinen."
choice_data_list:
Yeah. So I've identified areas for 
improvement.

Yeah. So I've singled out some points we 
can improve on.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: My— Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*!
choice_data_list:
One last rep, give it your all to the very 
end!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Yes—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Giving it their all. No phrase suited the 
two of them better."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —Haa, phew...! Just one more set...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Curren Bouquetd'or continues her 
self-training until right before curfew--"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
My dream is for more people to get to know 
you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"...So that their hard work will one day 
come to light. So that their name will be 
remembered—even in history."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
For that sake, I want to gather countless 
victories and dedicate every last one of 
them to that person—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
If it's for that—I'm certain I can 
overcome any wall, no matter how high.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"For that person's sake. She was not the 
only one who harbored that feeling."

text_block_list.name: Show Director
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer. It's already 1:00, though—
choice_data_list: Ah... I'm sorry, just a little bit longer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I want to do everything in my power to 
spread the word that Bouquet is a 
wonderful Umamusume and the leading star 
of this era."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer murmured the same, continuing to 
strive purely and wholeheartedly for 
victory."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*...! Trainer...! What was my 
time for the last furlong just nowâ?!
choice_data_list:
Congratulations, you beat your personal 
record!

Congratulations! You beat your personal 
record!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Fufu, yes—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "The Future Desired by Two of a Kind"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Their hoofprints continue onward across 
the Twinkle Series where fierce 
competitors run rampant. First up, towards 
the Takarazuka Kinen—"

"...And then. After much anticipation, the 
first broadcast was—"

text_block_list.name: Bouquet Fans
text_block_list.text: "Go for it! Bouquet, and Trainer <username>!!!"
(Uwooooooah...!)

It caused a far bigger sensation than 
anyone had imagined.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, those two are just so earnest, you 
can't help but want to root for them!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
That said, today's gotta be Chrono. She 
blew everyone away taking 1st in the fan 
voting, after all.

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's true, but still... Whenever I 
watch "Project U," the bonds are just so 
emotional! It really makes you wanna cheer 
for them!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"...For you to watch me this closely. I'm 
a little surprised."

While the goal was to showcase her 
presence, for it to create this much of a 
stir was a welcome surprise.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"'Now I'm looking forward to the 
Takarazuka Kinen even more.' 'With the 
bond between you two, I hope you challenge 
Almond Eye someday.' —My, hehe."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"So many people have praised us. —That 
makes me so, so happy."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
To meet the expectations of our fans, and 
to nurture their hopes even further—
choice_data_list:
Let's bloom even more beautifully and make 
it a race where you shine brighter than 
anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Yes—! Let us run with all our might...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And now, it is finally underway. The grand 
finale of the summer season, the 
Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
All eyes are on Chrono Genesis— she's 
shown remarkable performance since 
entering the Senior Class.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...Bouquet-san.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ――! Chrono-san.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"I know it's a bit late to say this, 
but—your performance in the Tenno Sho 
(Spring)... was truly magnificent."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"As an Umamusume who ran the same Tiara 
route, I felt immensely proud."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
That is precisely why... this dream of 
winning the Grand Prix is something I must 
seize no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"I will run with fierce strength just like 
you, and today, I shall defeat even 
you...!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Chrono-san...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"To hear that from someone like you is 
truly an honor. However—"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I cannot yield either. On this grand 
stage—I want to shine brighter than 
anyone.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
And like a sunflower swaying under the 
summer sky, I want to seize that single 
blossom of victory—without fail.

A warm, verdant early summer breeze blew. 
The curtain was about to rise on the 
Takarazuka Kinen!
